name: io.github.plus8bit/deadchannel
description: Check an x402 endpoint before you pay it: verdict, risk score and what is wrong. $0.001 in USDC.

environmentVariables.name: DEADCHANNEL_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a wallet holding a little USDC on Base. It signs payments locally and never leaves the machine. Not needed for the free health check.

environmentVariables.name: DEADCHANNEL_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the service endpoint. Defaults to https://deadchannel.vercel.app
